title: Lena and the Debt
author: Kestrel Amberdale
blurb: Bram Blackwood, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
